body: - The verdict (`target/cold-agent/verdict.json`) reads `passed` only on positive evidence — client exit 0, a successful `result`, `isolated` (exactly the fifteen `mcp__escher__*` tools, one server `escher`), `counts_agree` (the server's `tool_call` span lines against the transcript's escher tool uses, its refused + error lines against the results marked `is_error`), ≥ 1 tool call, all six apps in `tasks_met` (read from an accepted `snapshot` answer while the app is the latest accepted `start`'s, a paged screen read as the latest answer of each of its parts joined, never the agent's reply), each of `lint_calls` · `screenshot_calls` · `advance_calls` · `graph_calls` · `actions_calls` · `layout_calls` · `part_reads` · `list_opens` above 0, `recording_kept` (each accepted `start` left one kept check), `wrong_calls × 100 ≤ 5 × tool_calls`, and the agent's check — at most 400 steps, never replayed when malformed — replayed green on a fresh `escher-session mcp` child (`check_passed`) and failing with its acting steps left out (`check_can_fail`); `wrong_calls` decides the outcome against `wrong_call_bar_pct` (5 %), a run over it failing `wrong-calls-over-bar`, beside the reasons `capability-unused` and `recording-not-kept`. Events carry counts and identities only — no transcript text, tool argument, tool result, reply or check text.

- **Cold-agent run pipe (measured):** `bash scripts/cold-agent.sh {run stand | status | cleanup | logs}` — same exit grammar (`run counter` a usage error; `3` also when `target/debug/escher-session` is absent or not executable — the pipe builds nothing); `run stand` starts one isolated `claude -p` session (a per-run `mktemp -d` cwd holding only an `mcp.json` with one stdio server `escher`, the driver's own `escher-session mcp --record` into the owner-only `target/cold-agent/record/` (`mkdir -m 700`, its kept checks never printed, copied or committed) with its fifteen verbs, the driver's verbs, its stderr at `RUST_LOG=info` in `server.log`, counted by `tool_call` span lines and never printed — the stub `scripts/cold_agent_stub.py` deleted at 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test) asking for six apps one at a time — counter, flight booker (its return booking chosen on its flight type control, plus one screenshot), timer, CRUD, cells (plus one visual lint) and the load page — and a JSON check as the reply's last fenced json block and writes `target/cold-agent/verdict.json`: `passed` only on positive evidence (client exit 0, a successful `result`, `isolated` — exactly the fifteen `mcp__escher__*` tools, one server `escher` —, `counts_agree` — the server's `tool_call` span lines against the transcript's escher tool uses and errors —, ≥ 1 tool call, all six apps in `tasks_met` (a paged screen read as the latest answer of each of its parts joined), read from `snapshot` answers and never the reply, and the agent's check replayed green on a fresh `escher-session mcp` child (`check_passed`) and failing with its acting steps left out (`check_can_fail`)); `wrong_calls` deciding the outcome against `wrong_call_bar_pct` (5): `passed` also needs `wrong_calls × 100 ≤ 5 × tool_calls`, each of `lint_calls` · `screenshot_calls` · `advance_calls` · `graph_calls` · `actions_calls` · `layout_calls` · `part_reads` · `list_opens` above 0 and `recording_kept` (each accepted `start` leaving one kept check), else `wrong-calls-over-bar` · `capability-unused` · `recording-not-kept`. Proof: `test_cold_agent.py` under a `claude` shim and a fake `target/debug/escher-session` (answering Cells as a paged JSON line of two parts and the load page, keeping under `--record` one check per accepted start) + the live run, fired once at 2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar (passed, reasons none, all six apps met, `counts_agree` 66 · 66, `lint_calls` 1 · `screenshot_calls` 1 · `advance_calls` 1 · `part_reads` 2, `recorded_sessions` 6 with `recording_kept`, the check passed and able to fail (59 steps, 16 expects), 66 calls, 0 wrong of 66 against the 5 % bar, 0.8244 USD, `claude` 2.1.308). The live run is never in CI.

- 2026-11-14: In a `gate.py control` file a control's `case` names the test function alone — never prefixed by its test binary's or target's id. Extended 2026-11-16: its `holds` needs every named case to read failed, so a control names only the case its edit reddens — a second named case that still passes reads INDETERMINATE. Extended 2026-11-18: its case reader knows nextest, libtest and pytest result lines alone, so a control on the `ci-scripts` leg (unittest's `FAIL: {name} (…)`) reads INDETERMINATE «no result line» — read the named case from the removed log by hand.

A phase P5 control script that plants a host-path literal to prove a `/home/` probe reads red (a literal like
`/home/someone/x`) lands in the committed run dir, and `gate.py hygiene` P1 refuses it at the operator pass, costing a
respell and a re-fire there. Plant the control's literal in a form hygiene does not read as a host path — a
placeholder such as `/home/<user>/x` keeps the probe red and the run dir clean — from the first write.
Extended 2026-11-18: where hygiene still meets such a planted path, rewrite it to the `<user>` form and name it in
the card, without asking — the operator's standing ruling for this project.

body:
The session widened the cold-agent pipe over 0.3.0's carried reads: its counted verbs went from three to six (lint, screenshot and advance, plus graph, actions and layout).
The cold-agent verdict and its run.end event gained five fields: graph_calls, actions_calls, layout_calls, list_opens and refused_by_cause, each a count or an object of closed cause words to counts.
The capability-unused reason now requires eight capabilities at zero (adds graph_calls, actions_calls, layout_calls and list_opens), and the fixed stand prompt asks for the UI graph, what can be done, where the list sits and an opened list, naming no element id or app slug.
The pipe now reads the driver command span's existing cause field from the server log; no driver verb, carrier, argument, cause, session error, log field or span was added, and the wrong-call bar stays 5 percent, confirmed by the founder.
Retired the contract test that pinned layout_calls absent, replaced by one that counts the layout read in the run and replays it in the check; the contract tests went from 38 to 41.
The founder's forks were given after implement: graph and actions answers may cross to the model provider on the live run, and a served error page comes in 0.3.0 before the live run, so the live run must reach the caused ending.

body_fields.what: the cold-agent pipe — runs the fixed stand prompt against escher-session's mcp role, counts the counted verbs from the server log's span lines, and writes the cold-agent verdict, its reasons and the pipe's events (run.start, run.end, status, cleanup)
the cold-agent pipe's contract tests, with a fake escher-session and a claude shim, run on the ci-scripts leg

body: The decision that graph, actions and layout are not counted verbs for a cold agent is reversed: all three are now counted and required.
The cold-agent pipe's counted-verbs contract items (advance, lint, screenshot) gain three siblings: graph, actions and layout.

The capability-unused reason, in both the verdict's reasons list and the verdict contract, now reads eight fields at zero instead of four: lint_calls, screenshot_calls, advance_calls, graph_calls, actions_calls, layout_calls, part_reads and list_opens.
The cold-agent verdict's field set grew by five; the closed-verdict-fields rule now holds over graph_calls, actions_calls, layout_calls, list_opens and refused_by_cause.
The cold-agent pipe events' run.end event carries the five new verdict fields.
The rule that the cold-agent server log is read by span name only now also covers the command span's lines, from which the pipe counts the cause field per closed word.
The rule that the cold-agent server log is read only to count now covers counting refusals by cause; a word outside the eight closed cause words is not counted.

The refusal cause names (covered, disabled, fonts-unavailable, malformed, not-found, off-screen, stale, unknown-verb) are now read by the cold-agent pipe in the schema's order, as the keys of refused_by_cause; renaming or adding a cause now reaches the verdict.
The driver command span's cause field gains a reader: the cold-agent pipe counts it, without any field being added to the span.
The rule that the cold-agent verdict holds no content holds over the new fields: each is a count or closed words to counts.

The rule that decoded screen text stays in the match now covers the list opening count: the pipe decodes accepted click and press answers and keeps only a count of ListBoxOption rows differing in bounds alone.
The wrong_call_bar_pct value stays 5; the founder confirmed 0.2.0's bar of at most 5 percent wrong calls for 0.3.0.
The snapshot diff's open list row bounds item is now what the cold-agent pipe reads to count a list opening.
The cold-agent verdict's reasons order and the wrong-calls-over-bar reason stand next to the widened capability-unused set; the order is unchanged.

body_fields.fact: The cold-agent pipe counts six verbs from the server log: lint, screenshot, advance, graph, actions and layout.
The cold-agent verdict carries graph_calls, actions_calls and layout_calls, each a count of that verb's tool_call lines, written after advance_calls.

The cold-agent verdict carries list_opens, a count of accepted click or press answers whose changed list holds a ListBoxOption differing in bounds alone; an answer that does not decode as JSON is skipped.
The cold-agent verdict carries refused_by_cause, an object of the eight closed refusal cause words to counts, read from the command span lines' cause field; a word outside the eight is not counted.
The cold-agent run fails capability-unused when graph, actions, layout or a list opening is left unused, beside lint, screenshot, advance and part reads.

body: The driver's command and tool_call span contracts, their fields and endings: no span, field, verb or cause was added, and none changed.
escher's telemetry sink, its log line format, RUST_LOG handling, scrub set and target allowlist: no scrub-set key was added.
Engine tracing, the tracing-crate choice and the absence of a telemetry backend, metric emission or exporters.
Error capture and reporting: panic hooks, script error surfaces, window error events and WPT reports.
escher-session's commands, exit codes, host wire, coverage role, recording file and session lifecycle.
The graph, actions and layout answers' own shape, content and logging rules: the answers did not change, only how often they are counted.
The agent-run harness (not the cold-agent pipe): its events, test event and log rules.
CI platform, per-leg failure log and coverage report artifacts, and WPT publishing.

body_fields.name: Cold-agent transcript answers decoded only to be counted
body_fields.rule: The cold-agent pipe decodes the transcript's acting answers only to count list openings; an answer that does not decode is skipped, and the decoded answer leaves the pipe only as that count.
body_fields.because: The chunk adds a new read of the transcript's acting answers, a JSON decode whose undecodable input is skipped and whose content leaves only as the list_opens count, and no row of Input Validation states that boundary.

body_fields.value: The server's log is read only to count its tool-call span lines, their refused and error endings, each counted verb's accepted lines and its command span lines' refusal causes; it is never printed or copied.
body_fields.because: span_counts() now reads every server.log line and counts the command span lines' cause per closed word, so a rule naming only tool-call span lines no longer states all the log is read for.

body_fields.value: The fixed stand prompt takes six apps in turn, each started, led to its goal, snapshotted, stopped, asking the counter's UI graph, the flight booker's actions and its return flight by the flight type list, CRUD's layout, Cells neither, then the check as last json block; it names no id or app slug.
body_fields.because: STAND_PROMPT gains four asks (the counter's UI graph, the flight booker's actions and list-opened return flight, CRUD's layout, Cells asking for neither), and the row stating what the prompt asks must name them.

body_fields.value: A run where any of lint_calls, screenshot_calls, advance_calls, graph_calls, actions_calls, layout_calls, part_reads or list_opens reads 0 fails capability-unused.
body_fields.because: The capability-unused requirement set widens from four to eight fields, adding graph_calls, actions_calls, layout_calls and list_opens, so the reason's promise must name the set it reads.

body_fields.promise: The verdict counts six verbs, lint, screenshot, advance, graph, actions and layout, each as its own calls field.
body_fields.because: COUNTED becomes six verbs and the verdict gains graph_calls, actions_calls and layout_calls, a verdict field set no row of the area states.

body_fields.promise: An object of the eight closed refusal cause words, each a count of the command span lines refused with that cause; a word outside the eight is not counted.
body_fields.because: The verdict gains refused_by_cause, a new field of closed words to counts, which no row of the area states.

body_fields.promise: Counts the accepted click or press answers whose changed list holds a ListBoxOption differing in bounds alone; an answer that does not decode is skipped.
body_fields.because: The verdict gains list_opens, a new counted field read from the acting answers, which no row of the area states.

body_fields.name: Prompt goal controls pin a phrase standing once
body_fields.rule: A deletion control on a prompt goal pins the goal by a phrase that stands once in the prompt.
body_fields.why: A phrase that also stands elsewhere in the prompt makes the control vacuous.
body_fields.because: The chunk's control on the prompt test read DOES NOT HOLD on words shared with the Cells sentence and held on unique phrases, a convention for future controls that no row states.

body_fields.name: ci-scripts leg controls read by hand
body_fields.rule: A control on the ci-scripts leg is read by hand from its removed log.
body_fields.why: The gate's control reader reads only nextest, libtest and pytest case lines and reads unittest INDETERMINATE.
body_fields.because: Every control on the ci-scripts leg read INDETERMINATE under the gate's reader and was read by hand, a convention binding future controls of that leg that no row states.

body_fields.relied: The contract tests count refused_by_cause from the fake escher-session's command span lines, one per instance-verb call after its tool_call line, none for session verbs, help or an error ending.

body_fields.why: The basis only retells how the pipe's list-opening counter decodes and counts acting answers, stating no reason or choice, so the code holds it.

body:
The session widened the cold-agent pipe over escher 0.3.0's carried reads: its counted verbs go from 3 to 6 (lint, screenshot, advance, plus graph, actions and layout), and the capability-unused requirement set goes from 4 to 8 (adding graph_calls, actions_calls, layout_calls and list_opens).
The cold-agent verdict and its run.end event gain five fields, each a count or an object of closed words to counts: graph_calls, actions_calls, layout_calls, list_opens and refused_by_cause (the eight closed refusal cause words, read from the existing cause field of the command span lines in the server log; a word outside the eight is not counted).
list_opens counts accepted click or press answers in the raw transcript whose decoded changed list holds a ListBoxOption differing only in bounds; an answer that does not decode is skipped, and only the count leaves.
The fixed stand prompt gains four sentences: read the counter's UI graph, ask what can be done on the flight booker's screen and open its flight type list, ask where CRUD's people list sits and why it has its size, and ask Cells for neither; it still names no element id or app slug. The wrong-call bar stays 5 %.
No driver verb, carrier, argument, cause, session error, log field or span was added, and no scrub-set key; no live run fired, so no answer reached the model provider.
After implement the founder answered: F1 keeps the 5 % bar, F3 allows one live run under a 3 USD budget, F4 approves graph and actions answers crossing to the model provider on the live run, and F5 places a seventh served app (an error page whose authored error text would cross to the provider) in 0.3.0 before that run, superseding the ruling that caused text is out of the run's reach.

body_fields.what: the cold-agent pipe (cold-agent.sh) — its fixed stand prompt, its counted verbs, its server-log and transcript readers, its verdict and run.end event, its capability-unused reason and its wrong-call bar; edited
the cold-agent contract tests and their fake escher-session, which now writes a command span line per instance-verb call with its cause when refused; edited, one test retired and replaced

body: decision/cold-agent-screen-to-provider: the founder's F4 approves graph and actions answers crossing to the model provider on the live run, and the widened prompt now asks for graph, actions and layout reads; the row is to be restated at this wrap. No live run fired in this session.
decision/graph-answer-crossing and decision/actions-answer-crossing: the cold-agent run now asks the agent for these answers, so on the live run they cross to the model provider (approved by F4).

decision/caused-text-crossing: the ruling that caused text is out of the cold-agent run's reach is superseded by F5; a served error page whose authored error text crosses to the model provider is placed before the live run, a boundary widening its text names (not built in this session).
decision/cold-agent-fixed-prompt: the fixed prompt gains four sentences asking for the 0.3.0 reads and the flight type list; it stays fixed and names no element id or app slug.
decision/cold-agent-wrong-call-bar: its value stays 5 %, now on the founder's F1 (0.2.0's rule kept for 0.3.0); the pipe's comment still says it holds 0.2.0's bar until the founder's number.

decision/cold-agent-logs-metadata-only and decision/cold-agent-events-metadata-only: the verdict and its run.end event gain five fields, each a count or an object of closed words to counts; no content enters them.
decision/cold-agent-server-output-unprinted: the pipe now reads every server log line to count the command span's cause per closed word; it prints none of it.
decision/cold-agent-transcript-raw and decision/cold-agent-check-reader-counts-only: the pipe now decodes acting answers from the raw transcript to count list openings, keeping only the count.
decision/model-reply-untrusted-input: the new list-opening reader treats the transcript's answers as untrusted, decoding JSON and skipping what does not decode.
contract/command-span/cause and contract/driver-command-span/cause: the cold-agent pipe is a new reader of the command span's cause field; the field itself is unchanged.

decision/closed-refusal-cause-set, decision/refusal-closed-cause-set and contract/refusal-causes/*: the pipe holds its own copy of the eight closed cause words in the schema's order for refused_by_cause; the set is unchanged.

decision/select-list-crossing and decision/open-list-shot-pixels: the prompt now asks the agent to open the flight type select list and click its option, and list_opens reads a ListBoxOption bounds diff; only the count leaves the pipe.
contract/diff-node/differs: the pipe now reads the differs key of changed diff nodes (differs equal to bounds alone) to count a list opening.

decision/kept-check-graph-answer, decision/kept-check-actions-answer and decision/kept-check-layout-answer: the cold-agent run now asks for these reads, so on the live run its kept checks will hold those answers.

decision/closed-value-field-no-widening and decision/boundary-widening-rule: the five new verdict fields are closed-value fields (counts, closed words to counts), no widening; F5's error page names a widening still owed.
decision/cold-agent-call-validation: the pipe's counted verbs move from 3 to 6 (graph, actions and layout added) and the capability-unused requirement set from 4 to 8.

decision/live-runs-use-operator-login and decision/no-screen-content-in-logs: F3 allows one live run with a 3 USD budget limit, after the served error page exists; the run's evidence and logs stay content-free.

body_fields.fact: The cold-agent verdict and its run.end event carry refused_by_cause, an object of the eight closed refusal cause words to counts read from the command span lines in the server log, a word outside the eight not counted, and list_opens, a count; neither carries call input or screen content.

The cold-agent pipe decodes the transcript's acting answers only to count list openings (a ListBoxOption changed in bounds alone); an answer that does not decode is skipped, and the decoded answer leaves the pipe only as that count.

The founder approved (F4) graph and actions answers crossing to the model provider on the one live cold-agent run, and placed (F5) a served error page before that run, so caused text is in the run's reach and no longer out of it.

body: Driver verbs, argument kinds, refusal JSON, session errors and the session socket wire contracts: no verb, carrier, argument, cause, session error, log field or span was added or changed.
The MCP server's transport, protocol errors, request and result bounds, and the escher-session flags, roles and exit codes.
Authentication and authorization, CI tokens, publish secrets and signing material.
Dependency security: no crate, dependency or dev-tool version changed.
The engine's own input validation and error handling: HTML, CSS and SVG parsing, script fetch and URL scheme limits, select list keys, painting and closing, stable element id derivation.
Browser data protection: history database, cookies, HTTP cache, TLS, clipboard and file dialog.
API security's outbound HTTP, load waits, idle expiry and the absence rows of CORS, CSP and response limits.

body_fields.why: The set lengthens a fitting never-printed rule with one more item in the list of what the pipe counts, an inventory the pipe's code holds.
The set lengthens the no-ids rule with a list of what the prompt asks of each app, the prompt's sentences one by one, which the pipe's script holds.

Its capability-unused requirement set widens from four to eight: graph_calls, actions_calls, layout_calls and list_opens join lint_calls, screenshot_calls, advance_calls and part_reads, each failing at 0.
The verdict and its run.end event gain five fields: graph_calls, actions_calls, layout_calls, list_opens and refused_by_cause, each a count or an object of closed words to counts; no scrub key is added.

The wrong-call bar stays 5 %; the founder kept it for 0.3.0. No live run fired, and no driver verb, carrier, cause, session error, log field or span was added.
The offline contract tests grow from 38 to 41 cases; the test pinning layout as an uncounted read is retired and replaced by one pinning it counted and replayed in the check.

body_fields.what: edited — the cold-agent pipe: it runs the cold agent over the stand with the fixed prompt, counts its calls from the server log, and writes the cold-agent verdict and its run events
edited — the cold-agent pipe's offline contract tests under unittest, with the hand-written fake escher-session and claude stand-ins, run on the ci-scripts leg

decision/cold-agent-prompt-names-no-ids: the prompt is widened with four app sentences asking for the 0.3.0 reads and the painted list; the rule holds, pinned by the no-stand-id test.

contract/cold-agent-tasks/stand: the stand task the prompt gives now asks the counter for its UI graph, the flight booker for what can be done and its flight type list opened, CRUD for where its list sits, and Cells for neither.

Any row stating graph, actions or layout are uncounted reads of the cold-agent run, or naming three counted verbs: now six.
decision/mcp-capture-counts-by-span: the pipe's tool_call-span counts now cover six verbs, and it also reads the command span lines.

decision/eight-refusal-causes-in-order: indirect, the pipe now holds the eight closed cause words in the schema's order to count refusals by.

decision/mutation-controlled-tests: controls (a) to (d) ran red-before-green; a deletion control on a prompt goal was vacuous where the goal's words stood twice, and the ci-scripts leg's unittest controls were read by hand.
